correctness.rationale: Reconstructed actual RESULT.md at Git blob b5bdc9062b0d75fc5ff684cd90e21ef1697ee397. The neighborhood-intersection graph has same-layer index offset ±2 and cross-layer offset ±1. Index order a_(epsilon+2j), b_(epsilon+2j+1) partitions it into gcd(n,2) squared cycles; n=3/4 duplicate offsets remain a simple graph. The bijection with independent sets and k cyclic gaps >=3 gives coefficient m/k*C(m-2k-1,k-1)=m/(m-2k)*C(m-2k,k). Exact top coefficients after division of m by 3 give six branches, not merely an empirical pattern. Independent direct neighborhood enumeration for n=3..8 reproduced 1+6z+3z², 1+8z+16z², 1+10z+25z²+10z³ and further coefficient arrays. Infinite proof is the graph isomorphism/gap bijection, not the finite checks.
